professionalSummary: Software engineer with four years of experience on a warehouse control system team, implementing and testing control system changes in accordance with operations specifications and the team’s software standard.
experienceHighlights: Implemented 44 control system changes, each documented on a change record; tested each change on the emulation rig with a documented test record; took each change through the software review process with release approval from the control system lead; supported three distribution centres’ support desks with diagnostics and recorded incident handling; documented limitations and hand‑over conditions for every change.
projectsAndWorkSamples: Three change records with associated test records, review records, release approvals, and a one‑month support queue log, providing a verifiable trail of work.
optimizedCv.evidenceBoundary: The provided resume excerpts and work sample confirm the candidate’s experience and responsibilities as described; no evidence is provided regarding other roles, additional skills, or performance metrics beyond the stated achievements.

decisionBoundary.statement: The evidence supports all role requirements; human review recommended to assess fit and potential gaps.

evidence.text: Software engineer on the warehouse control system team of a retail distribution company for four years, implementing control system changes against the operations specialists' specifications under the team's software standard; forty-four changes in the period, each on a change record in my name.
evidence.notes: Direct statement of implementation under specifications.

evidence.text: Work sample: three change records with their test records, review records and release approvals, and one month's support queue log, with the change system references as a verification trail.
Tested each change on the emulation rig with the test record attached to the change record and checked by a second engineer.
Work sample: three change records with their test records, review records and release approvals, and one month's support queue log, with the change system references as a verification trail.
Took each change through the software review process; the release approval was the control system lead's, recorded on the change record.
evidence.notes: Describes review process and lead approval.

evidence.text: Reference call with the former control system lead: confirmed the candidate implemented and tested the changes in the period, with release approval staying with the lead, and confirmed the employment dates.
Supported the three distribution centres' support desks with diagnostics through the support queue, recording which incidents I diagnosed and which were passed to the automation vendor.
Work sample: three change records with their test records, review records and release approvals, and one month's support queue log, with the change system references as a verification trail.
Wrote the limitation note and the hand-over conditions of each change in the change record's closure section.
